solution.p: We differentiate implicitly both sides of the equation with respect to x. \ln y + \frac xy \, \frac{dy}{dx} + 7 y^{6}\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{5}{x}, so \left( \frac{x}{y} + 7 y^{6} \right) \, \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{5}{x} - \ln y, and thus \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{\frac{5}{x} - \ln y}{\frac{x}{y} + 7 y^{6}} = \frac{y\mathopen{}\left(5-x\ln\mathopen{}\left(y\right)\right)}{x\mathopen{}\left(x+7y^{7}\right)}.
